message: Last week we had a surprise blackout, and our family group chat lit up faster than my flashlight! Everyone was sharing tips on keeping our phones charged and what snacks to dig into from the pantry. It turned into a fun little game to see who could come up with the coziest way to wait it out. A little planning sure made the unexpected feel a lot more manageable. How do you keep the good vibes going when the lights go out?
